subject: Newcastle booed at home as Everton win 1-0 and Jaissle takes the blame
title: No shots, lots of boos

lines.vo: No shot on target in the first half. Newcastle still got booed.
Thierno Barry scored in the forty-ninth minute, after a shot squirmed under the keeper. Not a thunderbolt. A polite trickle.
Ugly goals count the same. Everton's first away league win of the season. They will frame it.
Jacob Ramsey was sent off late, for two yellows in eighty-six seconds. Some people take longer to order a coffee.
It was Newcastle's second straight home loss and fourth defeat in five games. They sit thirteenth. Only the volume is rising.
lines.footage: Matthias Jaissle press conference Newcastle boos

lines.vo: Matthias Jaissle took the blame and said they must improve. The crowd had already reached the same conclusion.
